coverage: Re-derived schematic pin placement from native symbol library coordinates and symbol placements (J1 at 180 deg, R1, C1, GND symbols, PWR_FLAG) in inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch; confirmed J1.1=/IN, J1.2=/OUT, J1.3=GND, R1 between /IN and /OUT, C1 between /OUT and GND, matching work/netlist/design.xml and work/netlist/connectivity.json.
Cross-checked all 7 board pad net assignments in inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb against the netlist (R1.1=/IN, R1.2=/OUT, C1.1=/OUT, C1.2=GND, J1.1=/IN, J1.2=/OUT, J1.3=GND): consistent.

Traced copper connectivity on the board: /IN segment (100,100)-(104.0875,100) joins J1.1 to R1.1; /OUT segments join R1.2 to C1.1 and J1.2 via the T-junction at (107.5,100) onto the y=100 /OUT segment; GND segment (110.95,100)-(113,100) joins C1.2 to the 0.6/0.3 mm via; J1.3 ground return closes on the B.Cu GND zone through saved thermal-relief spokes visible in the filled_polygon.

Verified geometry criterion directly from the native board file: all 5 track segments are width 0.25 mm >= 0.2 mm declared minimum, matching work/geometry/geometry.json (narrowest 0.25 mm); via (0.6 mm) and zone (min_thickness 0.25 mm, thermal_bridge_width 0.5 mm) also exceed 0.2 mm though not formally in scope of the track-segment requirement.

Verified the simulation deck work/rc-step/deck.cir against the netlist and values (C1 OUT 0 100n, R1 IN OUT 10k, GND mapped to node 0, J1 correctly excluded as element-free connector); stimulus PWL(0 0 1n 1) is a valid ideal-step approximation; .tran 0.005m 5m gives adequate resolution for tau=1 ms.

Recomputed the analytic response: tau = 10k * 100n = 1.0 ms; V(1 ms) = 1-exp(-1) = 0.6321206 V vs measured 0.6321201 V (within declared 0.62-0.65 V band); V(5 ms) = 1-exp(-5) = 0.9932621 V vs measured 0.9932621 V. ngspice.log measurement lines match the reported check details.
Confirmed board outline containment: all footprints, tracks, via (113,100) and zone (96.5-115.5 x 96.5-107.5) lie within the Edge.Cuts rectangle (96-116 x 96-108).

Reviewed ERC and DRC records (work/erc/erc.json, work/drc/drc.json): zero violations, zero unconnected items, zero parity issues; ignored-check lists are benign for this all-passive design; PWR_FLAG on GND is correctly placed for ERC.
Checked that the unconstrained vout_5ms measurement is consistent with inputs/requirements/fixture-requirements.md, which bounds only the 1 ms point.

findings.mechanism: Internal library assertions during a measurement run indicate the tool exercised an unexpected code path; a successful exit is not by itself proof the reported measurements are trustworthy, so the probe output needed independent confirmation.

findings.mechanism: If the saved fill were stale relative to an edited outline or clearance, or the single via failed in fabrication, the GND net would open with no redundant path; connectivity evidence here is the saved filled_polygon plus DRC/geometry unconnected counts of zero.
findings.reasoning: As saved, the ground net is demonstrably connected: the filled polygon shows thermal spokes reaching J1 pad 3, the via lands in an uncut region of the fill, and both DRC and the geometry probe report zero unconnected items. No declared requirement constrains ground redundancy or via count, and this is a disposable fixture, so this is informational rather than a defect; it is worth knowing that the entire GND return is a single via plus zone fill.
findings.title: Connector ground return depends entirely on saved zone fill and one 0.3 mm-drill via

limitations: work/rc-step/result.raw is binary and was not readable in this packet; waveform verification rests on ngspice.log measurement lines plus analytic recomputation.

B.Cu zone connectivity (J1.3 ground return) was verified from the saved filled_polygon geometry and the DRC/geometry unconnected-items counts, not by an independent refill or geometric recomputation of spoke widths; the read-only candidate forbids a refill pass.
Tolerance, temperature, external loading, ADC sampling, EMI and physical hardware behavior are outside the declared operating conditions and were not assessed, per the fixture's stated scope.

Footprint internal correctness (pad-to-land suitability of the stock KiCad 0805 and pin-header footprints) is taken from the standard library definitions embedded in the board file; no manufacturer land-pattern comparison was in scope.
